meta.title: Video Brochure Design Service
meta.description: Custom video brochure service from Video Caddy captures the essence of your brand, product, or service and makes marketing campaigns more effective.

hero.title: VIDEO BROCHURE DESIGN SERVICE
hero.subtitle: Video is undoubtedly the new-generation marketing medium that has the highest rate of brand recall.

services.title: VIDEO BROCHURE CREATION
items: We analyze the services or product features you offer and then produce a high-quality video brochure based on the specific needs of your target audience. We use a mix of photomontages of facilities and locations, employee audio recordings, management speeches, customer review recordings coupled with a concept color code and logo animations. All available communication material in print, audio, and video will be utilized and adapted to create a comprehensive video brochure.

services.title: PRIVATE CLUBS
items: We offer full video brochure editing services for companies in a range of industries as well, whether to update an existing brochure or to create a new brochure that highlights features of a new product or service you offer. We compile the latest information for your brochure, edit animations, cue in a few client interviews, or redo the audio logos to get a fully customized and up-to-date video brochure. We work in tandem with your marketing department or advertising agency to reduce costs and save time.

items.title: ADHERENCE TO ISO QUALITY STANDARDS
items.description: We maintain strict quality standards that ensure 100% adherence to turnaround time as per the agreed project terms and conditions.

items.title: CUTTING-EDGE INFRASTRUCTURE
items.description: Maintaining a highly sophisticated infrastructure for video editing and post-production, we use only the licensed version of the software - Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, and Edius Pro to ensure optimal performance.

items.title: ABSOLUTE DATA SECURITY
items.description: VCD assures taking every possible step to secure clients’ data against theft or unauthorized access.

items.title: SKILLED TEAM OF VIDEO EDITORS
items.description: With a skilled and experienced team of video editors and QC specialists, VCD delivers projects at the best cost to quality ratio.

midCta.title: PARTNER WITH VIDEO CADDY FOR CUSTOM VIDEO BROCHURE DESIGNS
midCta.description: Apart from video brochure services, keeping the requirements of corporates in mind, VCD has been offering a plethora of video editing services such as explainer video animation, whiteboard animation, corporate audio editing, and more.
